surfaces.label: Independent baseline security audit

candidate.recommended_remediation: Mint a scoped credential after a controlled join; rate-limit issuance per source and room without imposing a participant-count cap.
candidate.rule: Open-room joining independently discloses the same relay-wide bearer without an issuance throttle

supporting_source_evidence: Every join receives the same credential.
